Subject: POC kickoff & weekly check-ins — success criteria & timeline (Acme Industries)

Hi Liam and Priya —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. Quick recap and proposed plan so we all have the same picture going into the POC:

1) Success criteria (what Acme will measure):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for 1k token responses on Dedicated config.
- Cost: token cost <= $0.0012 per token (target with batching + 4-bit quant).
- Accuracy: pass 8/10 evaluation prompts for entity extraction & reranking (see attached).
- Integration: end-to-end ingest from your test S3 + Redwood inference endpoint via our SDK.

2) Evaluation plan / ownership:
- Acme will run daily evaluation suite (Priya) and flag regressions.
- Redwood will provide weekly regression report and model adjustments (Marissa + Michael).
- Rishi will be primary commercial contact for scope/contract questions.

3) Timeline & milestones (tentative):
- 2027-05-08: POC kickoff (virtual) — introduce engineers and share sandbox creds.
- Weekly (Thursdays) 30-min check-ins: status, blockers, evaluation results.
- 2027-05-29: Final readout / decision meeting (4 weeks).

4) Immediate next steps (this week):
- Redwood to send kickoff calendar invite + Drive folder (Marissa) — attached: POC_Success_Criteria.docx, Week1-TestPlan.xlsx.
- Acme to provide test S3 path and a list of sample queries (Priya).
- Acme procurement to confirm standard NDA/PO timeline (Daniel).

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria.docx; Week1-TestPlan.xlsx (stubs).

If that matches your understanding, we'll lock in the kickoff for 2027-05-08 at 09:00 PT.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
